verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API is broad. It covers broadcast create, read, update, delete and scheduling; broadcast and link stats; custom fields with bulk operations; account, colors, creator profile and growth stats; plus webhooks and bulk async processing. A remote MCP server also exposes subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments for read/write. Several UI features on the pricing page have no evidenced API equivalent: visual automations, A/B testing, polls, landing page and form building, digital product sales, and collaborative editing. Kit makes no explicit API–UI parity claim. missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment; API coverage of visual automations, A/B tests, landing pages/forms creation, commerce/digital products, and polls; a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404); independent corroboration.
